scope: Research only. No paid inference, credential access, configuration/source/index edits or external messages.

new_evidence.claim: Ollama OpenAI-compatible API cannot configure context size; documented workaround creates a local model, not a Cloud per-request limit.
Ollama contributor answered the Cloud num_ctx no-op report by confirming the served context is fixed at the model maximum and closing it as answered.
Ollama Anthropic compatibility documents unsupported count_tokens and an accepted-but-unenforced budget_tokens control.
Vercel explicitly documents budgets as soft caps checked before requests; the crossing request can finish.
Vercel Luna page documents maxOutputTokens as a hard generated-token cap including reasoning; this still requires source-verified wire mapping and does not bound its input.

OpenAI now documents exact model-received input counts including formatting at POST /v1/responses/input_tokens. No Vercel pass-through support evidence found, and Ollama does not advertise this endpoint.

alternatives_evaluated.cloud_num_ctx: Not a supported Cloud input cap, explicit negative evidence.
alternatives_evaluated.anthropic_thinking_budget: Accepted but unenforced, cannot use as hard bound.
alternatives_evaluated.provider_credit_budgets: Vercel soft caps do not bound the crossing request; account balance queries do not reserve a per-request allowance.
alternatives_evaluated.local_tokenizers_or_character_estimation: No verified provider-added formatting/context maximum for exact hosted route; cannot replace reviewed billable maximum.
alternatives_evaluated.raw_generate_or_legacy_completion: Different endpoint/prompt/tool semantics; no exact hosted tokenizer/template billing contract established, and classifier remains unbounded. Not silently substituted.
alternatives_evaluated.token_count_api: Potential supported solution for the classifier if Vercel/Bifrost explicitly exposes same-payload exact count with proven billing/provider binding; current support not established. Does not solve Ollama answers.
alternatives_evaluated.max_tokens_zero_probe: Would be a paid/unknown-bound call itself and zero semantics not established; no probe performed.

input_only_context_reservation_scenarios.qualification: Illustrative whole-context scenarios, not attested complete maxima. Excludes output, fees and other calls.

required_missing_guarantee: A provider-supported input-count or input-token/cost limit, bound to the final serialized request and model/provider route, covering every billable addition and all physical/hosted attempts; plus supported reasoning-inclusive output limits and complete fee ceilings.

conditional_target_math.qualification: Not an approved contract. Targets illustrate affordability if hard maxima become proven. Component-upward integer rounding used.
